The failing test `testTwoCompleteOptions` in the `OptionBuilderTest` class is trying to create two `Option` objects using `OptionBuilder`. The first option is created with a long option of "simple option", is required, has arguments, has a type of `Float`, and has a description. The second option is created with a long option of "dimple option", has an argument, and has a description.

The current bug report mentions that `getParsedOptionValue` returns null unless the `Option.type` gets explicitly set. The user expects it to default to `String` unless set to any other type. This behavior could be fixed in the `Option` constructor or in `CommandLine.getParsedOptionValue`.

Looking at the code snippets of `OptionBuilder` methods, we can see that there is no method to explicitly set the type of the option. This could explain why the user expects the option type to default to `String` but it defaults to null instead.

To fix this issue, we can add a method in `OptionBuilder` to set the type of the option explicitly. This will ensure that the option type defaults to `String` if not explicitly set.

Next, I will suggest the best locations to fix this issue.
